note: Active matched-job reference set after t151 (2026-11-14). The skirt hull's brim input moved from the emitted brim beads' centreline to the brim area's outer contour (canonical `Print::_make_skirt`'s `m_objectBrimAreasByInstance[...]` `area.contour.points`), so the skirt ring shifts outward by half a flow spacing (0.178-0.180 mm measured) and six cells move. The two base supports-on cells are byte-identical BY MEASUREMENT: the first-layer support footprint clips the whole brim area, so `area` - and therefore `brim_points` - is empty and the skirt hull has no brim input to change; the delta audit proves zero moved sections and zero changed E lines there. Every hash reproduced across the ordinary and accelerated output arms (8/8), and the baseline arm reproduced t148's active set in 8/8 in the same campaign.

inert_cells.reason: first-layer support footprint clips the whole brim area, so the module's `area` is empty and no brim point enters the skirt hull; unchanged by t151

superseded_set.note: t148's active set, which the t151 baseline arm reproduced in 8/8 cells in the same campaign. The two supports-on base hashes are identical to the active set above because those cells are inert.
